agent.problem: The earlier cards say only that the son asks for a fish. They give no basis for choosing "snake" over "stone" or "thorn," so the blank asks for wording the baker has not seen and cannot reason out.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

agent.problem: The stop never conveys that the one who seeks finds (Luke 11:9-10). Card 2 names seeking, and cards 2-3 cover the promises connected with knocking and asking, but no story or choice card gives the promise connected with seeking, leaving out part of Jesus' threefold teaching.

rule.text: When the baker leaves Prep, they understand the whole passage without missing an important detail.
